repos.desc: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.
